Run the server's in-memory simulation, optionally with modified parameters

Source: R/server.R
apsim_run.Rd

Runs the .apsimx the server holds, optionally overriding model parameters for this run. The file is not reloaded, so an adaptive sweep pays the load cost once. Read the results with apsim_output().

Usage

apsim_run(server, changes = NULL)

Arguments

server

An open apsim_server handle.

changes

A named list of parameter overrides: names are APSIM model paths (for example "[Wheat].Phenology.MinimumLeafNumber"), values are R scalars (numeric, integer, logical, Date, character) or a numeric vector (passed as a double array). NULL (default) runs the file unchanged.

Value

Invisibly TRUE on success; errors carry the simulator's message.

Examples

# \donttest{
f <- apsim_example("Wheat")
if (!is.na(f) && apsim_available()) {
  srv <- apsim_server(f)
  if (!is_apsim_abstention(srv)) {
    apsim_run(srv)
    close(srv)
  }
}
# }
